subject.title: fix(ui): open the start screen from the sidebar brand

question: Should fresh profiles and Reset pinned items use Usage, Cron Jobs, and Plugins rather than the empty default introduced by the preceding cleanup?
rationale: Both choices are technically supported and tested, but reversing the newly merged empty default is a user-facing navigation policy decision that CI and source review cannot settle.

options.title: Keep the combined behavior
options.body: Land the canonical `/new` navigation fix together with Usage, Cron Jobs, and Plugins as the fresh and reset default.

options.title: Narrow to navigation only
options.body: Preserve the empty pin default and land only the brand destination correction.

recommendation.title: Keep the combined behavior
recommendation.body: Land the canonical `/new` navigation fix together with Usage, Cron Jobs, and Plugins as the fresh and reset default.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the current empty default and brand target, authored the proposed correction, and has the strongest recent history in the affected UI paths.
